Garde les coffres universels pour la res: Keep universal chests for the resource that blocks you when the time comes.

Monte par tranches de 10 niveaux. Les bo: Upgrade in steps of 10 levels. Bonuses only exist on gold and purple pieces.
<b>Tour de guet</b> : tes héros gagnent: Watchtower: your heroes gain levels with every win. Start with your weak heroes to give them experience, and add your strong heroes little by little when you get stuck.

Equipment bonuses count in the tower: your weak heroes clear the floors and gain levels. Remember to re-equip your first team afterwards.
<b>Cabanes d'ouvriers</b> : elles n'augm: Worker huts: they don't only raise speed, they also add combat power.

Chantiers courts quand tu joues, chantie: Short builds while you play, long builds before work or at night.
<b>Demande l'aide de l'alliance avant d': Ask for alliance help before using a speed-up: help removes time for free.
Un bonus de vitesse ne retire pas un pou: A speed bonus does not remove a percentage of the time: real time = base time ÷ (1 + bonus). With +100%, a 10-hour build takes 5 hours.
Une file arrêtée faute de ressources est: A queue stopped for lack of resources is a resource problem, not a speed problem: send gatherers.
<b>Une seule équipe de 5 d'abord</b> : c: One team of 5 first: focus EXP, shards and equipment on it before building a second one.

Deux tanks devant, les attaquants derriè: Two tanks in front, attackers behind. Read the skills rather than choosing by power number alone.
Certains héros SSR ont une version UR à: Some SSR heroes have a UR version to unlock later: they are worth the long-term investment.
L'EXP coûte de plus en plus cher (un niv: EXP gets more and more expensive (one level after 70 costs over 5 million): don't spread it over heroes you don't play.
Deuxième équipe : construis-la autour d': Second team: build it around another faction, with the heroes that don't fit in the first.
Garde les <b>fragments universels UR</b>: Keep universal UR shards until your final team is settled, and use them on a Thursday.
Enregistre des formations séparées (boss: Save separate lineups (boss, attack, garrison) as soon as the feature unlocks (castle 16).

<b>Ce que donne chaque pièce or au nivea: What each gold piece gives at level 0 (values shown in the forge):
Dans un combat type, les trois héros arr: In a typical fight, the three back-row heroes deal about 90% of the damage. The two tanks deal 10%.

Les brassards or lui ajoutent environ 80: The gold bracers add about 800 ATK (+5%) and 12,000 HP.

<b>Vérifie sur tes combats</b> : rapport: Check on your own fights: battle report → Combat Stats → Damage dealt. Equip first the hero with the longest bar.
Une pièce or neuve repart du <b>niveau 0: A new gold piece starts again at level 0: keep enough to raise it to level 10 right away, to unlock its first bonus.

<b>Recycle ce qui ne sert plus</b> : dém: Recycle what you no longer use: dismantling a piece of equipment gives iron ore, which replaces part of the pig iron needed to craft a gold piece. Dismantle useless green and blue pieces, and even purple ones if it brings you closer to the next gold piece for your first team.
N'améliore pas l'équipement de bas nivea: Don't upgrade low-level equipment or the gear of heroes you don't play: keep your materials for the first team.

🎯 Attaquer une ville : lire la défense d: 🎯 Attacking a city: read the defence first
<b>C'est un projet d'alliance</b> : on n: It is an alliance project: nobody attacks a city alone. The target and the time are decided by the alliance and announced in chat, long in advance when it is planned, or on the spot when we have to react to an attack.
<b>Sois réactif</b> : une attaque peut ê: Be reactive: an attack can be launched at the last minute. We can also lose a city, which then goes under a shield: we take others to keep our sources of resources and progress.
<b>Ville vide ?</b> Si personne ne la dé: Empty city? If nobody defends it, attack all out, solo, with everything you have.
<b>Sinon, envoie un éclaireur</b> une fo: Otherwise, send a scout once the attack has started: it shows you how many troops are defending, and the defence can grow fast.
<b>Connais la puissance de ta première é: Know your first team's power and compare it with the defence. A team that is too weak won't get through: you lose troops and time.
Contre une vraie défense, <b>rejoins les: Against a real defence, join rallies rather than attacking alone. Look at the open groups: time left, whether they are nearly full, where they leave from. The same players often launch them.
Mets 1 ou 2 équipes dans les ralliements: Put 1 or 2 teams in rallies depending on how many you have. Once a big group has broken the defence, the rest can attack solo.
Adapte-toi vite selon les rapports de co: Adapt quickly based on the battle reports: it comes with practice, battle after battle.
Quand tu fais marcher tes troupes, le je: When you march your troops, the game shows their travel time. Remember it, and watch march speeds to estimate arrivals.
<b>Avec un compte à rebours</b> (ouvertu: With a countdown (start of a war, rally): launch your march when the countdown reaches your travel time. You arrive right at zero, together with everyone else, and the hits land together.
Si tu n'es pas prêt à temps, mieux vaut: If you are not ready in time, better to miss a wave than arrive alone and get beaten: get ready for the next one.
<b>Soigne souvent et en petites quantité: Heal often and in small amounts. If your infirmary is full, new wounded cannot get in and those soldiers are lost.
Lance des soins de <b>300 à 500 soldats<: Heal 300 to 500 soldiers at a time and ask for alliance help: with help taps, a small heal finishes almost at once, without speed-ups. Your soldiers are ready right away, and you start the next healing wave.
Adapte la taille selon tes bonus de soin: Adjust the size to your healing bonuses (buildings, research): choose the amount that help alone can finish.
Tout soigner d'un coup coûte beaucoup de: Healing everything at once costs a lot of resources and time, and blocks the infirmary meanwhile.
<b>Garde un maximum de troupes</b> : alt: Keep as many troops as possible: alternate attacks and healing, take the time you need. Better to slow down than lose your whole army in a frantic attack.
Les R4 et R5 déclarent la guerre à une v: The R4s and R5 declare war on a city, one at a time. The time is announced in chat: be online and join the rallies with your best team.
Une ville prise est protégée 24 heures,: A captured city is protected for 24 hours, then it has to be defended.
<b>Comment une ville est gagnée</b> : pe: How a city is won: during the declared war, all members' points add up. 100 damage to the defending troops = 1 point; 1 point of durability removed from the city = 5 points. When durability reaches zero, the city goes to the alliance with the most points, not to the one that lands the last hit. Hitting the walls therefore pays a lot.
La ville appartient à l'alliance. C'est: The city belongs to the alliance. The alliance leader appoints the lord (and the knights): it is not necessarily whoever attacked most, and the title can change hands.
Les déclarations sont limitées : 3 par j: Declarations are limited: 3 per day (2 in season), one target at a time, and the alliance needs at least 20 members. Once we own a city, we can only target neighbouring cities.
Le seigneur et les chevaliers de la vill: The city's lord and knights renew the decree every day: it ends at midnight server time (1 am in Paris).
Chaque siège joué compte dans ta note de: Every siege you play counts in your participation score (40% of the score), and so in the sharing of city chests.
Siège de la Capitale le vendredi : il fa: Capital Siege on Friday: the alliance needs a level 6 city and you need castle 12 to enter the zone.
Garde des accélérateurs de soin et d'ent: Keep healing and training speed-ups for siege days.
Le samedi est le jour « Kill » : sans bo: Saturday is "Kill" day: without a shield, your troops give points to the enemy. Put up your shield on Friday evening, before 1 am (Paris time).
Mets de côté assez de points d'alliance: Set aside enough alliance points during the week to buy one in the alliance shop.
Tu peux aussi abriter tes troupes ailleu: You can also shelter your troops elsewhere: reinforcing a shielded player or an alliance city. Careful: if your castle is zeroed, your troops come home.
Rappelle tes récolteurs : ce jour-là, le: Recall your gatherers: on that day, gathering troops are easy targets.

Le principe du programme VS de l'allianc: The idea behind the alliance's VS schedule: prepare on the quiet days, cash in on the day it counts.
<b>Tâches d'Intel (lundi, mercredi, vend: Intel Tasks (Monday, Wednesday, Friday): finish your tasks the day before without claiming the rewards, then claim everything at once on the day. You can set aside about thirty (up to 35 according to the alliance schedule) by starting the morning before. Tuesday, Thursday and Sunday are therefore stocking days.
<b>Récoltes</b> : les points sont compté: Gathering: points are counted when the gathering ends. Send your troops the evening before so they finish just after the next day starts (1 am in Paris).
<b>Constructions (mardi)</b> : un bâtime: Construction (Tuesday): a finished building only gives its points when you open its completion gift. During the week leave the gifts closed and open them on Tuesday. In the settings, turn on claim confirmation so you don't open them by mistake.
<b>Recherches</b> : même logique, fais-l: Research: same logic, make it finish on Wednesday, and keep one research completion for Saturday.
<b>Chariots et primes UR (mardi et vendr: UR wagons and bounties (Tuesday and Friday): on the days before, do your missions so that only UR ones are left waiting. Always launch your UR ones before refreshing the list, otherwise you lose them. Starred bounty tasks can be kept: save them for duel day.
<b>Soldats (vendredi)</b> : pendant la s: Soldiers (Friday): during the week, train troops one level below your maximum. On Friday, only do promotions to the next level: points are those of the final level, for far less time and fewer speed-ups.

Le pacte de non-agression entre grandes: The non-aggression pact between the big alliances, as announced on the kingdom Discord, and what it means for us.
Mis en place par les trois premières all: Set up by the kingdom's top three alliances, announced in the alliance on 4 November 2026 and on the "Kingdom #116" Discord on 5 November. The 15 strongest alliances do not attack each other, so everyone can gather, build and train in peace. The rule applies to the whole server.
<b>On n'attaque aucun joueur d'une allia: We attack no player of a top 15 alliance. No castle attack, no scouting, no attack on a gathering tile.
<b>En cas d'attaque, on ne riposte pas.<: If attacked, we do not strike back. We first tell the R4s and the R5, who settle it between leaders.
<b>Pas de menaces ni de harcèlement</b>: No threats or harassment towards members of pact alliances, anywhere on the server.
<b>Sanctions</b> : en cas de récidive, l: Sanctions: in case of repeat offences, victims may sanction their attackers, and this works both ways.
Les annonces de l'alliance (4 et 8 novem: The alliance announcements (4 and 8 November) and the kingdom Discord all say top 15. On 10 November the question of a top 10 was raised between leaders, with no answer so far. Until something else is announced, the top 15 is protected. [LoVS] was in the kingdom's top 10 at our latest readings.
🔎 Avant toute action contre un joueur: 🔎 Before any action against a player
Vérifie la place de cette alliance : ton: Check that alliance's place: your profile → Rankings → Alliance Power (or Alliance → Settings → Alliance list).
Dans le top 15 : on ne touche pas. En ca: In the top 15: hands off. If in doubt, ask in alliance chat before sending your troops.
🚨 Si tu es attaqué, ou si tu as attaqué: 🚨 If you are attacked, or attacked by mistake
Take a screenshot of the report.
Envoie-la tout de suite à un R4 ou au R5: Send it right away to an R4 or the R5 by private message.
Les dirigeants règlent le problème par l: The leaders settle the problem through diplomacy.
🛡️ Ce que le pacte ne couvre pas: 🛡️ What the pact does not cover
Les joueurs sans alliance ou hors du top: Players without an alliance or outside the top 15 can still attack you: keep a shield up if your castle is not defended.
Le samedi du duel d'alliance (jour de co: On Alliance Duel Saturday (combat day), only attack the targets given by the R4s and the R5: ask before aiming at a pact alliance.
Regarde une tuile de récolte avant d'y e: Look at a gathering tile before sending troops, so you don't hit a protected player by accident.
Depuis la version 1.0.41, le Roi peut pr: Since version 1.0.41, the King can issue three laws: non-aggression (castles), trade protection (wagons) and bounty protection.
Une loi <b>n'empêche pas</b> techniqueme: A law does not technically prevent attacking: each violation triggers a warning and stays on public record.
Le Roi peut ensuite sanctionner : une «: The King can then punish: a "brand" with a negative effect, or "Wanted" status (5 minutes without shield or teleport).
Lis les lois en vigueur avant d'attaquer: Read the laws in force before attacking outside a war.
Les vétérans, les piliers : ils montrent: The veterans, the pillars: they set the example, give advice, take part, communicate and read announcements and mails. They logically receive more rewards.
Communique sans beaucoup participer, ou: Communicates without taking part much, or takes part without communicating or answering. Or waiting to be re-evaluated.
Nouveau dans la famille, le temps de fai: New to the family, time to prove themselves. Or a player who doesn't communicate, doesn't answer or contributes very little.
Les R1 peuvent être remplacés petit à pe: R1 members may be replaced little by little. Newcomers are protected for 3 days.
<b>Absence de plus de 24 h : préviens un: Away for more than 24 hours: tell an R4, who will inform the team. Without news, more than a day away raises the risk of dropping to R1, or even being removed.
Ta participation ou ta communication s'e: Has your participation or communication improved? Ask the R4s or the R5 for your promotion: something may have been overlooked.
Une suggestion sur ce fonctionnement ? C: A suggestion about how this works? Contact the R4s or the R5.
Les cibles (villes, sièges, ralliements): Targets (cities, sieges, rallies) are decided by the R4s and the R5 and announced in chat.
Les coffres de ville sont partagés selon: City chests are shared according to participation: sieges, help, donations and kills (Chests tab).
On ne quitte pas l'alliance pendant la s: Nobody leaves the alliance during duel week.
Mets un nom de joueur reconnaissable (pa: Use a recognisable player name (not the default one) to make communication easier.
Les annonces du jour sont dans Chat → Al: The day's announcements are in Chat → Alliance → Alliance Announcement: read them every time you log in.
Le cargo du soir suit une rotation de ca: The evening cargo ship follows a captain rotation: see the 🚢 Cargo tab.
